help.title: How to keep your data safe
help.body:
Everything is stored only on this iPhone. If the phone is lost or broken, the data is gone unless you have a backup somewhere else.

• Tap "Back up now" at least once a week and save the file to Files → iCloud Drive / a USB drive, AirDrop it to a Mac, or send it to yourself on WhatsApp or email.
• To keep a copy on a Windows PC: connect the iPhone, open the Apple Devices app (or iTunes) → Files → TransformPro, and copy the "backups" folder.
• Automatic daily backups also stay on this phone, so they do NOT protect you if you lose the phone.
